items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: So we had Bob Schottman to stand over me, the whole time in between the pitches.

ctx.x: But you watch the stick. And I see a lot of fellas that used to get out there in the deep, we call it out in the deep water, and they call WP Pound Plenty, and things like that. But when he do this, that means give y'all triple 40, and then you see him, one of those things, for sound, you know, boom, you know. And just like a double P, you start off, you know, and you get to, when you get to the, to your top volume, well you just come right on back to where you started, you know. It's a term for that. And so he…
So when you started playing music, you just went into music professionally, you didn't have any other profession.
